units.source_text: 以前，实际上是不太久以前，太吉郎和西阵的织布商或地方的主顾还经常到上七轩去寻花问柳。

en.t: In the past, though in fact not very long ago, Takichiro would often go to Kamishichiken with Nishijin textile merchants or customers from the provinces to seek pleasure in the pleasure quarters.

units.source_text: 那时候遇见的一些女子的形象，不由自主地又在他的脑海里浮现出来。

en.t: The images of some of the women he had met in those days rose again in his mind against his will.

units.source_text: 那阵子，太吉郎店铺的买卖还十分兴隆。

en.t: In those days, Takichiro's shop was still doing very prosperous business.
